claims: Artemis II is targeted to launch on Wednesday, April 1, 2026.
Artemis II has a two-hour launch window opening at 6:24 p.m. ET.
Artemis II will lift off from Launch Complex 39B at NASA's Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
Artemis II will send four astronauts on a 10-day flyby around the Moon.
Artemis II launch date is April 1, 2026 (NET - No Earlier Than).
Artemis II launch time is 6:24 p.m. ET (opening of a two-hour window).
Artemis II launch location is Kennedy Space Center, Florida (LC-39B).
If the Artemis II launch does not occur on April 1, additional windows are available through April 6.
There is another launch opportunity for Artemis II on April 30.
Artemis II's mission goal is to test NASA's Deep Space Exploration systems, including the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket and Orion spacecraft with a human crew.
Live coverage of Artemis II will be available on NASA's YouTube channel.
Live coverage of Artemis II will be available on NASA+.
Live updates on Artemis II will be provided by Florida Today.
